title: Conscious and Unconscious Memory Systems
relation: Clarifies conscious and unconscious memory systems and separates working memory from long-term memory.
relationZh: 这篇帮助区分显性可陈述记忆、隐性表现型记忆和工作记忆，适合修正 agent memory 的术语边界。
description: A review of conscious and unconscious memory systems, including declarative memory, priming, skills, habits, conditioning, and working memory.
descriptionZh: 文章系统梳理 conscious / unconscious memory systems，强调不同记忆类型在意识、行为表达和脑系统上的差异。
readingFocus: 先分清 working memory 和 long-term memory。
重点看 declarative memory 为什么是 conscious recollection。
把 nondeclarative memory 当成 performance-based memory 来读。
映射到 agent 时只做功能类比，不做同构断言。
